record.dc:title: Modern Database Management (Sixth Edition)
record.dc:creator: Jeffrey A. Hoffer, Mary B. Prescott, Fred R. McFadden
record.dc:subject: Database Management
record.dc:description: A book designed for an introductory course in database management. It represents an extensive revision and updating of the fifth edition of Modern Database Management. These revisions are necessary to accommodate the technical, managerial, and methodological changes occurring at an ever-increasing pace in this field.
